prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and channel priorities. I can recommend agencies, but first it helps to know what you need.

Quick questions so I can give a tailored recommendation:
- What are your primary goals? (e.g., brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, app installs)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, paid search/PPC, social ads, creative/content, email, ABM)
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)?
- Company stage/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; SaaS, retail, fintech, etc.)
- Timeline and any must‑have capabilities (analytics, creative studio, CRM integrations)

If you want a fast, general shortlist, here are common top choices by specialty (examples, not ranked as “best”):

- Performance marketing / paid media: 3Q Digital, Tinuiti (performance focused agencies known for PPC, paid social, analytics)
- Creative & branding / integrated digital: R/GA, AKQA, Razorfish (large, full‑service agencies with creative + tech)
- SEO & content: agencies with strong technical SEO teams (I can shortlist local specialists once I know budget)
- B2B / demand generation: boutique B2B agencies that focus on ABM, content and Salesforce/HubSpot integration

How to pick the right agency (checklist):
- Look for case studies with measurable KPIs similar to your goals
- Ask for references from clients in your industry or of similar size
- Confirm team structure and who will be your day‑to‑day contacts
- Review their measurement approach and reporting cadence (what metrics and tools)
- Check contract terms: scope, deliverables, exit/notice, performance benchmarks
- Make sure they can integrate with your stack (analytics, CRM, tag management)

Sample questions to ask agencies:
- What measurable results have you achieved for companies like ours?
- Which channels drove the best ROI and why?
- Who will be on our account and what are their backgrounds?
- How do you attribute conversions across channels?
- What is your onboarding process and expected 30/60/90 day milestones?

If you tell me your answers to the questions above (goals, channels, budget, industry), I’ll create a short, customized list of 4–6 San Francisco agencies that fit and include recommended questions and a suggested scoring sheet to compare proposals.
